sloka: प्रेक्षणीयाः सुगन्धाः च भ्रमरैः च वर्जिताः ।कण्डुर् नाम महाभागः सत्य वादी तपो धनः ॥४-४८-१२॥
transliteration: prekṣaṇīyāḥ sugandhāḥ ca bhramaraiḥ ca varjitāḥ ।kaṇḍur nāma mahābhāgaḥ satya vādī tapo dhanaḥ ॥4-48-12॥

translations.english: There was a sage called Kandu who was truthful, outrageous and shorttempered. He observed strict austerities and was rich in penance.
